name: paparats
description: Self-hosted semantic code search across all your repos. Search by meaning, follow callers through a symbol graph, and get exact chunks instead of whole files. Runs on your machine; your code never leaves it.

server_url.title: Paparats server URL
server_url.description: MCP endpoint of your Paparats server. Keep the default for a local install; use /support/mcp for the support endpoint, or the address of a shared server.
